title: Two chat prompt files load outside the chat docs state: the classifier prompt and the YouTube prompt template.
evidence: Classifier half: chat-classifier-prompt.md is an optional doc in ChatDocsState (OPTIONAL_DOC_FILES.classifierPrompt, ChatDocs.classifierPrompt in app/lib/chat-system-prompt.server.ts); classifyMessage reads chatDocs(), its 60-second cache is gone (US-15 AC81). Left: app/lib/youtube-context.ts still reads chat-youtube-prompt.md at import. No longer held: PR 2183, which changed that file, merged 2026-11-26. Next step: bring app/lib/youtube-context.ts into ChatDocsState.
